tests.name: the data contracts with the approval of the consumers for a breaking change (ST-DGV-005, DGV 3.1 F2, DGV-13, DGV-19, UAT-AC50) is registered in the module of DGV

the data contracts with the approval of the consumers for a breaking change (ST-DGV-005, DGV 3.1 F2, DGV-13, DGV-19, UAT-AC50) UAT-AC50: a breaking revision waits for every consumer (409 listing who), then for a window (422), and is then published as an immutable version with its hash while the version before it serves to the end of the window; an optional column is backward compatible
